tools.name: check_diet_fit
tools.description: Returns fits, does_not_fit or uncertain for one food product and one diet, with the rules that decided it and their sources. Give either a barcode (looked up in Open Food Facts) or the product's ingredient list and label claims. Uncertain results are queued for review by a registered dietitian; trea

tools.name: get_diet_rules
tools.description: Returns the full, versioned rule set used by check_diet_fit, with every rule's source and the decisions log.
